rfam.comment: Telomerase is a ribonucleoprotein reverse transcriptase that synthesises telomeric DNA. Telomerase RNAs differ greatly in sequence and structure between vertebrates, ciliates and yeasts, but they share a 5' pseudoknot structure close to the template sequence [1,2]. The structure of Tetrahymena telomerase has been reported in 6D6V, 7LMA and 7LMB [3,4].
